lede: Mark took three more and leads by four. Anthony lost all four of his teams and fell to seventh. Brian closes the week tonight with a game he can't lose.

beats.text: Baltimore, Chicago and San Francisco all delivered and only the Raiders went down, to Jon's Chiefs in the one game that mattered most. Thirteen points and his biggest lead of the season. The catch: Lamar Jackson hurt his ankle before halftime in Baltimore and didn't come back.

Four teams, four losses, zero points, and a drop to seventh. The Jets managed 157 yards in Chicago, Brissett threw three picks including a pick-six, Denver got sealed by a Kittle screen, and Philadelphia blew a fourth-quarter lead while losing Saquon Barkley to a hamstring. Two of his last three weeks have been blanks.

beats.tag: Patrick · From last to joint second
beats.text: Three more points: the Browns on Thursday, Jonathan Taylor running over Washington in London, and Carolina winning his own civil war in prime time. Nine points, level with Jon, and a fortnight ago he was alone at the bottom. Nobody has moved further.

beats.tag: Zach · A real week at last
beats.text: The Rams came from behind in Philadelphia and the Packers edged Tampa — both the games the market said he'd win, and he won them. Four points. It's still last place by three, and the Chargers are 0-4 with Herbert on a pace no Chargers quarterback has managed since Ryan Leaf, but it's movement.
